question: Add a new method ConsumeMetricsWithContext(ctx context.Context, md pmetric.Metrics, opts ...ConsumeOption) error to the Metrics consumer interface. This interface is implemented by all metric processors and exporters in the OTel Collector pipeline. Jaeger uses it for span metrics.

jaeger.description: Jaeger uses the spanmetricsconnector from OTel Collector Contrib for its Service Performance Monitoring (SPM) feature. Jaeger does not directly implement consumer.Metrics but configures the OTel Collector pipeline with the spanmetrics connector.
jaeger.impact: Jaeger's SPM pipeline uses connector/spanmetricsconnector which holds a consumer.Metrics reference. The spanmetricsconnector.connectorimp calls consumer.Metrics.ConsumeMetrics to export aggregated span metrics (call counts, duration histograms, event sums). After the interface change, the spanmetricsconnector would be updated in contrib, and Jaeger would automatically benefit from the new ConsumeMetricsWithContext method when upgrading its OTel Collector dependency.
